plain_english: Remember: it's not the person who insults you or hits you that hurts you. It's how you see these things as hurtful. So when someone makes you angry, know that it's your own thoughts making you angry. First, don't let appearances fool you. If you can pause and give yourself time, you'll control yourself much better.
original_excerpt: Remember that it is not he who gives abuse or blows, who affronts, but the view we take of these things as insulting. When, therefore, anyone provokes you, be assured that it is your own opinion which provokes you. Try, therefore, in the first place, not to be bewildered by appearances. For if you once gain time and respite, you will more easily command yourself.
